skill.summary: Get AI generated videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts or images (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, up to 200MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate AI-powered videos from text or images for free.

- Upload text prompts or images and generate 1080p MP4 video clips within minutes.
- Seamless onboarding with automatic token retrieval and session setup.
- Supports popular file types (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, and more; up to 200MB).
- Cloud rendering pipeline handles editing, exports, and stateful sessions.
- Simple commands for uploading, editing, checking credits, and exporting.
- Built for content creators and marketers seeking fast, no-filming video generation.
